# Sockt — AI-Native Workforce Platform
# https://sockt.dev
# License: FSL-1.1-MIT (converts to MIT after 2 years)

## What is Sockt?
Sockt is an AI-native workforce platform that deploys preconfigured AI employee swarms directly into Slack. Agent departments coordinate, remember, and compound in intelligence over time, with built-in loop prevention, persistent memory, and credential isolation. Teams bring their own LLM key; Sockt adds orchestration, memory, and safety.

## Canonical Pages
- Homepage: https://sockt.dev
- Departments: https://sockt.dev/departments

## Core Technical Concepts
- FSM (Finite State Machine): Sockt uses a hierarchical FSM to coordinate agent tasks. No horizontal agent-to-agent messaging. Loops structurally cannot form.
- GBrain: Persistent fleet memory. Agents commit learnings after each session; the next run starts with context. Deduplication at cosine similarity > 0.92.
- CADVP (Context-Aware Daemon with Versioned Persistence): Background daemon that commits memory without polluting the active context window.
- Secret Vault Proxy: API keys never enter agent scope. A compromised agent has nothing to exfiltrate.
- BYOK (Bring Your Own Key): Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio all supported.

## Departments
- Growth & Lead Gen: Intent signals, lead enrichment, outbound drafting. 70–90% automation on first-contact drafting.
- Product Development: Ticket → spec → sandboxed execution → PR. 60–80% automation on junior-to-mid dev tickets.
- Engineering Ops: Alert → root-cause hypothesis → runbook update. < 15 min from alert to hypothesis.

## Open-Source
Sockt Community Edition is open-core under FSL-1.1-MIT. Core packages: OSS-Orch, OSS-FSM, OSS-Memory, OSS-CLI.
GitHub: https://github.com/sockt-dev/sockt
